Question ID: ALG1_U05_UA_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.A1.FND.6

Simplify (3x²+4x-5)+(2x²-x+8).

feedback.text: Combine like terms: 3x²+2x², 4x-x, and -5+8.
This adds constants and x-terms incorrectly.

feedback.text: Each term must also divide the variable factor x.

answer.text: Neither, because quadratics cannot model length

feedback.text: Quadratic area equations can model side lengths.
